relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from front matter: the document self-identifies as arXiv:1303.5278v1, and its four-author byline and title match the registered entry. CITATION STATE: a true bib orphan — zero sites in content/ and zero in computations/. RELEVANCE: it promotes the 3D index from a triangulation-dependent collection of q-series to a topological invariant of oriented cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds, by showing a triangulation admits an index structure iff it is 1-efficient and that hyperbolic manifolds carry a canonical family of such triangulations related by index-preserving 2-3 and 0-2 moves. QOU uses the 3d index directly: lean/QOU/QBeta/GZWeightSelection.lean:20-24 asserts the A_omega Stokes constant is the integer DT/BPS 3d-index count [q^0] Ind^rot_{4_1} = 3, citing garoufalidis-gu-marino2021 for the count but with no source for the index's well-definedness. This document is that missing source. Held at supporting because the QOU argument uses a specific coefficient rather than this invariance theorem, but the invariance is what licenses calling it 'the' index of 4_1.

keyResults.statement: An ideal triangulation admits an index structure iff it is 1-efficient; a hyperbolic cusped manifold has a canonical set of 1-efficient ideal triangulations related by 2-3 and 0-2 moves that preserve the 3D index, so the index is a topological invariant of the manifold.
keyResults.useForFolio: Licenses the phrase 'the 3d index of 4_1' used when reading off [q^0] Ind^rot = 3 in the Stokes-constant argument, which currently presumes triangulation-independence without a source.

proposedActions.rationale: GZWeightSelection.lean reads a specific 3d-index coefficient off 4_1 as if the index were canonically attached to the manifold; that well-definedness is this document's theorem and is currently uncited anywhere in the corpus.
